build_regression_head: build a RegressionHead with in_channels and num_joints to predict keypoint coordinates directly
forward_regression_head: forward multi-scale feature maps through the RegressionHead to get predicted keypoint coordinates
predict_keypoints: predict keypoint coordinates from features with optional flip test augmentation for test-time augmentation
calculate_loss: calculate the keypoint regression loss and PCK accuracy from predicted outputs and ground truth labels
review_regression_head_init: review the RegressionHead initialization with SmoothL1Loss, decoder config, and default Normal weight initialization
